entries.title: Talk with the crewmate on a secret or integration card
entries.body: The cards that ask you to save a secret, use one, move secrets in, or allow an integration now name the task that asked and take a reply, which reaches that crewmate. On a card with a secret's field, Chat opens the conversation beside the card, so you never type a reply next to a secret. Words left in the field when you press Don't save, Don't allow, Don't bring or Not now reach the crewmate too.

picture.alt: A card asking to save a Stripe test key, naming the task Wire up the checkout, with the conversation open beside it holding a question to the crewmate.
